about: Query set for the evaluation. 100 queries, written by Claude in-session and to be reviewed by the team. Rule: docs/EVALUATION.md, section 'Query set'.

rule.narrow: 50 chunk ids drawn with random.Random(0).sample(range(136), 50). One question per chunk, aimed at a specific fact in that chunk.
rule.broad: 50 questions on topics covered by at least two of the three articles (judged from their section headings).
